To: Maria Jackson <mjackson @ardinmail.com>

Subject: Retirement news

Dear Maria,

I'm writing to let you know about my retirement in a few weeks. The last time we
talked, I mentioned that I was thinking about retiring, but now I'm really doing it!

You are one of the first people I wanted to tell personally about this, given how
important you have been in my career. If you had not taken a chance and hired me as a
local restaurant reviewer all those years ago in San Diego, I may never have become a
journalist. It's been a very rewarding career, and I owe much of it to you! But now, I
